gap: No result ChatGPT got states that on the budget '4-channel front/rear/left/right' cams, the left and right views come from lenses on the windshield unit that also serve as the cabin cameras. REDTIGER's own F17 Plus page calls its side views a '360° rotatable dual cabin lens' with IR, and Rexing says the side cameras on the R4-RD and L4 'rotate inward for optional cabin monitoring'. These cams make you choose between the two sides and the cabin; they can't record both, and their side views are cabin cameras turned outward, which is the same kind of camera ChatGPT used to rule out the Vantrue N5S.
standout_why: Dashlore (cited) lists only one 4-channel cam, the Vantrue N5S, which has two cabin cameras. It covers no Rexing models, no VP40, and REDTIGER only as the 2-channel F7NP. It also makes no point about side lenses doubling as cabin lenses, or about how many of the four sensors are STARVIS 2. I couldn't read Car and Driver (cited): the fetch was blocked, so I can't say what it covers. ChatGPT's own answer recommends the F17 Plus as its 'top pick for side coverage' and marks the N5S down for having cabin-facing cameras. It never says that the F17 Plus maker describes its side views as a rotatable dual cabin lens. I did not open the uncited mydrivecar, caraudioradar or recsmatter pages because the stores rate-limited me and I ran short of tool calls.
decides: This weakens ChatGPT's split between 'true side' cams (F17 Plus, Rexing R4/R4 Pro/C4, VP40) and the N5S's 'cabin views'. On these cams the side channels are rotatable lenses on the windshield unit. Their makers market them as cabin cameras that can be turned outward, or side cameras that can be turned inward, so they look out through the front side windows from the windshield, just as a cabin camera does. That supports our N5S pick for rideshare and cabin use. For a shopper who wants door and side-swipe evidence, it means the pick comes down to the front camera and how many STARVIS 2 sensors the cam has, not to a 'side camera' advantage. Counted that way, the N5S has four STARVIS 2 sensors and the VP40 has two. The R4 Pro, F17 Plus and C4/R4 are effectively one premium front sensor plus three 1080p lenses.
